opportunities.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks — Askable
opportunities.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.


How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.<

opportunities.title: Build a Rust-first Cloudflare MCP installer with selectable release channels
opportunities.description:
**Outcome:** A user can choose a Diffyn release, review the proposed Cloudflare resources and costs, deploy into their own account, connect an MCP client, and later upgrade or roll back to a verified version.

**Size:** Multi-stage engineering project. This is not a good first issue.

**Status:** Proposed roadmap work. The first deliverable is a reviewed architecture and privacy decision; implementation should follow in separate, testable pull requests.

## The problem to solve

Diffyn currently runs as a local Rust stdio MCP server. Its published Linux container has no HTTP listener. A hosted client cannot use those packages simply by supplying a Cloudflare URL.

This is an **optional, user-owned deployment path** with an explicit privacy boundary. Local installation remains available. Before the first remote implementation, document how requests, authentication records and operational logs are handled by the deployment and its infrastructure providers.

## Choose the right Cloudflare service

| Component | Purpose in this proposal |
| --- | --- |
| Workers | Hosts the remote HTTPS MCP endpoint. Rust application logic is compiled to WebAssembly. |
| Access or another supported identity provider | Controls who may use the deployed service. |
| MCP server portal | An explicit installer option that presents the deployed HTTP MCP server through Cloudflare's access controls. |
| Cloudflare Containers | Alternative to evaluate only if the WebAssembly route has a demonstrated block
